name: Horseradish

schedule.notes: Plant root cuttings (sets) at 45° angle, top 2 in below soil. Contain in a buried bottomless bucket — spreads aggressively.
Lift after frost; flavor peaks in fall. Save side roots for next year's planting.

harvest.cues: Roots are 8 to 12 in long, 1 to 2 in across at the top. Tops are wilting from frost.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh in fridge 3 months in plastic. Grate and mix with vinegar (1:1) to preserve heat — keeps months refrigerated.

varieties.name: Common Horseradish
varieties.notes: The basic. Hard to source as anything else.

notes: Plant in a sunken bottomless container or your own corner — left to itself it'll take over the bed via root fragments. ALWAYS grate outdoors or with windows open; oils burn eyes and lungs.
